nodes.label: ML-DSA-44 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 2 post-quantum digital signature algorithm parameter set offering AES-128 security level based on Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS) hardness.

nodes.label: CXL 3.1 Security Protocol and Data Model (SPDM) Attestation Mechanism
nodes.description: Hardware-level cryptographic authentication and key exchange protocol in CXL 3.1 enabling root-of-trust verification and link encryption across fabric endpoints.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Morphological Analyzer (CALIMA Star) Subsystem
nodes.description: Out-of-vocabulary robust morphological analysis engine in CAMeL Tools generating full feature grids (root, lemma, POS, person, gender, number, aspect, mood) for Modern Standard and Dialectal Arabic words.

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 QL Profile Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation specifying a profile of OWL 2 designed for query answering against large amounts of instance data via direct relational database query rewriting.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Sparse General Matrix-Matrix Multiplication (SpGEMM) Kernel
nodes.description: High-performance algebraic kernel executing parallel sparse matrix product C = A * B over arbitrary semirings, serving as the foundation for multi-hop graph traversals and pattern matching.
